heading: Direct vs Regular Mutual Funds: Understanding SEBI's Default Rule
tldr: Regular mutual funds include distributor commissions, leading to higher annual expense ratios.
Direct mutual funds allow you to invest directly with the Asset Management Company (AMC), resulting in lower expense ratios.
SEBI has mandated that from November 1, 2026, direct plans will be the default option on AMC digital platforms for new investments.
This regulatory change aims to increase transparency and empower investors to save on costs over the long term.
Opting for direct plans can significantly enhance your accumulated wealth due to the power of compounding with lower fees.
caption:
Did you know you could be paying extra fees on your mutual fund investments without even realising it? From November 2026, a new rule means you'll automatically get a cheaper option when investing online. This small change can save you a lot of money over time and help your savings grow faster! 🌱 Learn how this helps you in our latest article.
